FINAL: no public source of how this door takes the payment (pr agent 3 run 59, 2026-11-27, read only). Every place looked: (1) pyfile-toolkit/nano-llm-api @ cbca76cf3435547b1bd2def008065a5947df32da (still the head on 11-27, last commit 2026-09-20): courier.mjs:1-185 is the courier job (validate, topological chain order, attach work, process via rpc.nano.to), with no fee or payment check; server.mjs:85-138 is the chat door (X-Nano-Payment <hash>); README.md:38 calls Nano a legacy rail with X-Nano-Payment. No /data/nano/courier gate in the repository. (2) pursekeeper/api @ 21d187f7e8e825bb7846818c969307307bee8704: no examples/purchases directory for this door (only pyfile-search-2026-10-05 and the unrelated oso-pepe-courier ones); the sellers-page capture in ochq-page-extract-2026-10-18/paid-2.body.json says the route 'took four 0.02876 payments (09-20 x2, 09-24, 09-26) and delivered no job block; after their 2026-09-27 fix a chain job of mine went through on 2026-09-28 00:20 UTC', but that capture is truncated at 50000 characters before the pyfile-courier entry itself; examples/research/2026-10-22-quote-validity rows.json has the 402 only (decodable, accepts, 0.02876, stable). (3) rpc.nano.to account_history of pursekeeper's nano_1i3y944... filtered to this payTo: the 09-28 00:20:33Z send of 2.876e28 raw is on chain (9D509ABE020C...), and so are later ones on 09-30; a block shows that money moved, not which header or body carried it. (4) The pursekeeper/api#1 thread and the operator's other repositories are not reachable from this session (repository-scoped API). So the header, the body (the job chain) and whether the payment send rides inside the chain are not public. Stays 'no: settle unread' until the operator publishes the gate or a paid call's headers.
